contacts.cardBody: We can find which of the e-mail addresses in your contacts are on Droblet. First we explain what is sent.
contacts.consentLead: Before you allow it, know what happens:
contacts.consentWhat: On your phone, the e-mail addresses in your contacts are turned into SHA-256 hashes with a single-use salt that changes on every request. Only these hashes are sent.
contacts.consentNot: Names, phone numbers and the e-mail addresses themselves never leave your phone.
contacts.consentStore: The hashes are used only to find your friends on Droblet and are not stored; because the salt changes, they are useless anywhere else.
contacts.consentOptional: Droblet works the same if you don't allow it. You can withdraw the permission at any time in your phone's settings.
contacts.deniedBody: To find your friends, allow contacts access in Settings. Nothing was sent.
